pages.text:
Simon says
stand.
“Simon says stand.”
The kids did it.

Simon says
tap.
“Simon says tap.”
The kids did a tap.

Simon says
stamp.
“Simon says stamp.”
Stamp, stamp, stamp.

Simon says
spin.
“Simon says spin.”
The kids did a spin.

Kick.
“Kick.” Nick did a
kick. He was out.

Nick sat and had
a rest.

Simon says
stand, tap, stamp,
spin, kick.
“Simon says stand,
tap, stamp, spin, kick.”
